newsitem.title: USA: Northstar says Guarino resumes as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Northstar says Guarino resumes as CFO.

text.p: Northstar Health Services Inc said Tuesday Lisa Guarino will resume her former duties as chief financial officer on September 1, filling a vacant post.
Guarino, currently a financial consultant to the company, served as Northstar's chief financial officer from November 1995 to September 1996.
The healthcare company also named Frank Spramelli, currently of Three Rivers Health Plan in Pittburgh, chief administrative officer effective September 1.
Finally, the company named Michael Fournier, director of the company's outpatient facility in Indiana, Pa., as president of its Keystone Rehabilitation Management subsidiary.
